title: DashboardWidgetDefinition
description: A single dashboard widget definition, describing a self-service search/list widget that a dashboard-capable FOLIO app can render against one of its own resources. The `definition` block configures the columns available for the results table, quick-search matching, structured filtering, and sorting.

type.description: The widget implementation this definition targets.

version.description: Version of the widget type's own configuration format.
Version of this specific widget definition.

name.description: Display name of the widget, e.g. `ERM Licenses`.

baseUrl.description: API path the widget queries for `resource` records.

resource.description: Name of the resource type the widget lists/searches.

results.description: Columns available in the widget's results table.

matches.description: Fields the widget's free-text quick search matches against.

termConfigurable.description: Whether the user can choose which of these fields to search.

filters.description: Fields available for building structured filters.

sort.description: Fields the results table can be sorted by.

configurableProperties.description: Per-instance widget settings a user can override when adding this widget to a dashboard, keyed by property name.

configurable.description: Whether the user may override this property.

defValue.description: Default value. Type depends on the property.

DashboardWidgetFilterColumn.description: A field available for building a structured filter.

filterPath.description: Dot-path/query field the filter is applied to.

valueType.description: Value type the filter compares, e.g. `String`, `UUID`, `Date`, `Enum`, `Array`.

resource.description: For `valueType: UUID` reference filters, the related resource type to look up candidate values from.

comparators.description: Comparison operators the UI may offer for this filter.

enumValues.description: For `valueType: Enum` filters, the allowed values.

DashboardWidgetMatchColumn.description: A field the widget's free-text quick search matches against.

accessPath.description: Dot-path into the resource record to match the search term against.

default.description: Whether this field is matched by default.

DashboardWidgetResultColumn.description: A single column in a dashboard widget's results table.

accessPath.description: Dot-path into the resource record used to derive the cell value.

valueType.description: How the UI should render the cell value.

arrayDisplayPath.description: For `valueType: Array` columns, the dot-path within each array item to display.

DashboardWidgetSortColumn.description: A field the widget's results table can be sorted by.
